# V6.43.24 — Local opportunity source map

Purpose: ground local landing-page differentiation in verifiable public context without turning a commune into a stereotype or a service limitation. Product copy translates these facts into optional training opportunities; it does not imply that every resident uses them.

## Peñalolén
- Municipalidad de Peñalolén — Parque Quebrada de Macul: https://www.penalolen.cl/medio-ambiente/parque-quebrada-de-macul/
- Municipalidad de Peñalolén — Parque Peñalolén: https://www.penalolen.cl/medio-ambiente/parque-penalolen/
- Municipalidad de Peñalolén — Diagnóstico Integrado PRC: https://www.penalolen.cl/avances-del-plan/etapa-de-diagnostico/
Evidence used: precordillera, parks and trails, sport/recreation space, valued neighbourhood/community life and natural environment.

## La Reina
- Municipalidad de La Reina — Nuevo Proyecto Mejoramiento Integral / green and active-mobility connections: https://lareina.cl/nuevo-proyecto-mejoramiento-integral/
- Municipalidad de La Reina — municipal park directory (Parque Mahuida / Aguas de Ramón listed): https://www.lareina.cl/
Evidence used: residential/green setting, parks, precordillera access and active-mobility connections.

## Las Condes
- Municipalidad de Las Condes — PIIMEP: https://www.lascondes.cl/landing/piimep/
- Municipalidad de Las Condes — Deporte y Vida Sana: https://www.lascondes.cl/municipalidad/deporte-y-vida-sana/
Evidence used: parks and green infrastructure, sport spaces, pedestrian/cycle/public-transport planning and varied places to be active.

## Vitacura
- Municipalidad de Vitacura — Planes de movilidad sustentable: https://vitacura.cl/municipalidad/planificacion-urbana/planes-de-movilidad-sustentable/planes-de-movilidad-sustentable/
Evidence used: residential/green character, walking and cycling, parks, cycleways and lower-speed neighbourhood environments.

## Providencia
- Municipalidad de Providencia — Ciclovías: https://providencia.cl/provi/vive/movilidad/ciclovias
Evidence used: human-scale mobility, walking/cycling and the possibility of integrating daily movement into the training context.

## Ñuñoa
- Municipalidad de Ñuñoa — Rutas / tourism and neighbourhood public space: https://www.nunoa.cl/turistica/rutas/
- Municipalidad de Ñuñoa — municipal site: https://www.nunoa.cl/
Evidence used: neighbourhood life, parks and plazas, public-space activity and local sport programming.

## Lo Barnechea
- Municipalidad de Lo Barnechea — Parques y Áreas Verdes: https://lobarnechea.cl/disfruta-lo-barnechea/que-hacer/parques/
Evidence used: parks, mountain setting, trails/open-air recreation and sport. Outdoor activities are always phrased conditionally ("if this is already part of your life") and incorporated as workload/recovery context, never assumed.

## Editorial guardrails
- Commune reality is framed as an opportunity, not a handicap.
- No socioeconomic, demographic or lifestyle stereotype is inferred from an address.
- No local asset is presented as something every client uses.
- Service availability remains affirmative; local context only personalises how the service can fit.
- Presencial / Híbrido / Online remain product choices, not fallbacks caused by a commune.
- ES and EN express the same product truth.
